emergency_thesis: An untrusted pull request job can make a protected release job consume attacker-controlled cache state in a documented cache restore workflow.
maintainer_objection: maintainers may say the cache producer is trusted by design

capability_closure.current_proven_capability: trusted artifact mutation in a synthetic local workflow
capability_closure.plausible_unproven_capability: credential exposure from a real release pipeline
blocked_routes: real third-party CI tokens are not used in public validation
